name: The Devil took my Candies
source:
This looked like a very boring Halloween for Léa, until a demon kidnapped her candy! (and her little brother!)
Meet friends, fight the devil and discover your inner magic ✨

"The Devil took my Candies" is a cute Halloween Visual Novel with 4 different ending !
translation:
莉娅原以为这个万圣节会很无聊，直到一个恶魔抢走了她的糖果！（还有她的弟弟！）
结识朋友，迎战魔鬼，发现自己内心的魔法✨

《The Devil took my Candies》是一部可爱的万圣节视觉小说，共有4种不同结局！
